note: Red River Appraisal District's parcel service (RedRiverCADWebService, BIS, services6.arcgis.com) returns 'Token Required' on the service root and on /0/query, so it is not public. The district's parcel viewer (maps.pandai.com/redrivercad) is gated by reCAPTCHA. No other public ArcGIS parcel service for Red River County was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches; remaining sources are commercial downloads (Regrid, Dynamo, Equator, texascountygisdata).
